title: Order Hold, Restocking and Appointment Figures — Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty
content:
Ordered Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty sets are held for installation, and installation appointments are booked, on the following line figures.

| Line | Special-order lead time | Hold after purchase | Restocking fee on cancellation | Bay time per appointment | Booking horizon | Minimum notice | Late release | Appointment moves allowed |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Crestline Value Touring 40K Treadwear Warranty | 2 business days | 14 days | 0% | 60 min | 30 days | 2 hours | 15 min | 2 |
| Crestline All-Season 50K Treadwear Warranty | 2 business days | 14 days | 0% | 60 min | 30 days | 2 hours | 15 min | 2 |
| Crestline Grand Touring 60K Treadwear Warranty | 2 business days | 14 days | 10% | 60 min | 30 days | 2 hours | 15 min | 3 |
| Crestline Highway Terrain LT 65K Treadwear Warranty | 3 business days | 21 days | 15% | 75 min | 30 days | 4 hours | 15 min | 3 |
| Crestline Premium Touring 75K Treadwear Warranty | 3 business days | 14 days | 10% | 60 min | 30 days | 2 hours | 15 min | 3 |
| Crestline Ultra Touring 85K Treadwear Warranty | 3 business days | 14 days | 10% | 60 min | 30 days | 2 hours | 15 min | 3 |

- **Special-order lead time:** business days (Monday to Friday, excluding the store's published holidays) a size not in store stock takes to arrive from the distribution center.
- **Hold after purchase:** calendar days an ordered set is held after its purchase date awaiting installation.
- **Restocking fee:** percent of the price per tire times the number of tires on the ticket; 0% on the 40K and 50K lines, 10% on the 60K, 75K and 85K lines, 15% on the Highway Terrain LT 65K line.
- **Booking horizon:** calendar days after the booking date within which an appointment may fall; **minimum notice:** hours between the booking and the appointment start.
- **Late release:** minutes after the slot start after which an absent customer's bay slot is released.
- **Appointment moves allowed:** times one installation appointment may be moved before the order must be re-booked as new.
